body: VALLEDIA THE EVEN, the far-seeing sorceress queen, leader of the Amurites in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; female; in her early fifties; slender and very still. Pale olive skin, a long straight nose, fine lines at the eyes and mouth, black hair streaked with silver and pinned up severely, cool grey eyes.
costume: a high-collared deep purple robe with lilac lining and silver piping, a silver chain belt.
signature: On her brow, whatever else she wears, a slim silver circlet holds a single glowing VIOLET SEEING-STONE.
extra: Her face gives almost nothing away: brows level, mouth closed and even, her head held very straight.

vibes.name: Seeing Stone
vibes.line: Her right hand writing with a silver stylus in a small book held open in her left, never looking down; the stone on her brow blazing violet, eyes wide and unfocused on a far point past the viewer; a tower roof at midnight under a sky thick with stars.
vibes.wears: a seer's loose robe of pale silver-grey silk, its long sleeves fallen back from her wrists, a hood of sheer grey gauze lying around her shoulders.

vibes.name: The Even
vibes.line: Her left hand stilling the swing of a hanging bronze brazier by its chain, her right dropping a pinch of incense into it; her face split evenly, half brazier red and half dawn violet, eyes straight at the viewer; her tower chamber in the hour before dawn.
vibes.wears: her ruling robes: a severely cut, high-collared deep purple robe with lilac lining and silver piping, a silver chain belt.

vibes.name: Necessary Murder
vibes.line: Turning a small painted seashell over in the fingers of her right hand, her left hand cupped beneath it, never looking at it; eyes level on the rain-streaked window, the barest nod; her study on a grey rainy afternoon, flat cold light, the door just closed.
vibes.wears: a plain black wool gown buttoned high to the throat, with long tight sleeves and no ornament but the circlet.

vibes.name: Futures Weighed
vibes.line: Holding a sphere of violet light in each hand at equal height, a tiny burning city inside the left, the same city at peace inside the right; eyes lowered to the burning one; the domed hall of her mage school at noon, a shaft of sun from above.
vibes.wears: the formal robes of the first archmage of the Amurites: deep crimson velvet with wide sleeves, borders embroidered with gold runes, a tall stiff collar.
